تشترفوا (form VIII)
# تَشْتَرِفُوا (taštarifū) /taʃ.ta.ri.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَرَفَ (ištarafa)
# تُشْتَرَفُوا (tuštarafū) /tuʃ.ta.ra.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَرَفَ (ištarafa)
